summary: Turns each bug or idea email sent to the NovaDesk support inbox into a complete ticket for the dev team in the Jira project NOVA, within seconds and never twice. AI decides the type, product, priority and label, and writes the ticket in English: context, description, steps to reproduce, expected and actual result, impact, investigation leads and acceptance criteria; screenpipe then notifies you with an "Open in Jira" button. When the AI is not sure, nothing is created and screenpipe sends you a "Sort by hand" notification. Nothing runs until you turn it on.
